name: shared-service-ownership
goal: Only services with two distinct runtime consumers appear in Services; single-consumer implementations live beside their owner while public contracts and registered identities remain stable

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Require two distinct actual runtime owner units for Services inclusion and Used In links. Colocate all 195 initially confirmed private service capabilities with their owners, preserving identities, implementations and public entries.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized catalog and card-grid suites accepted a single-consumer service and indirect page fallback. Extend their shared fixtures with zero, one, duplicate, missing and shared owners; extend metadata and source-move coverage with service cases and a frozen relocation ledger.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test commit 13db0192 fails owner-local placement (317 missing moved sources). Immutable red 272452fb7114118e8219f9ec942e9f42c0ae8616866917d3b733713ecedffa73. The same metadata suite fails all eight service-owner cases; browser desktop captures six cards where only the shared service should appear.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Resolved source runtime owners control service inclusion and Used In links. All 195 private implementations live in supported owner areas, with 318 AST comparisons and stable registered identities. Public source imports, framework hooks, store entries and their module contracts are preserved.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Final unchanged corpus passes at e003afd5: paired green 155125e02f4c60c74e45cf84f6eb994ce0cd05aa94e01f9157071fd6b9ccc970, paired red e902aebb retained. Source move guard, 28 metadata cases, 3 responsive browser cases and 19 catalog assertions pass with no unexpected browser errors.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
